title: Marsh Strategic Growth Initiatives Project Manager, IMEA
reasons: keywords: strategy, consulting, transformation, commercial, revenue, growth, business development, stakeholder +3
description: Company: Marsh Description: Marsh Strategic Growth Initiatives Project Manager, IMEA We are seeking a talented individual to join our Marsh Strategic Growth Initiatives team, part of our risk business at Marsh. This role will be based in Dubai . This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. The Marsh Strategic Growth Initiatives Project Manager will coordinate and deliver strategic growth initiatives across Marsh’s priority sectors in the IMEA region. Working closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, sector leaders, and stakeholders across Marsh’s business lines, you will translate strategic priorities into structured, executable programs that deliver measurable commercial impact. This role combines project and program management, strategic coordination, governance, stakeholder engagement, and operational oversight. You will ensure that initiatives are delivered effectively, that project bottlenecks are escalated promptly, and that teams remain aligned to agreed priorities, milestones, and outcomes. We will count on you to: Lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic projects, from scoping and planning through execution, impact measurement, and continuous improvement. Translate sector strategies into structured project plans, roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, success measures, and clear accountability. Establish and maintain effective governance, including progress tracking, risk and dependency management, escalation protocols, and performance reporting. Proactively identify project bottlenecks, delivery risks, resource constraints, and dependencies, ensuring that appropriate escalations are made promptly and clearly. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders. Coordinate sector leadership forums and stakeholder meetings, ensuring clarity of priorities, effective decision-making, action tracking, and follow-through. Monitor delivery against milestones, budgets, pipeline impact, and commercial objectives, providing structured insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Develop dashboards, presentations, and executive updates that communicate progress, key risks, decisions, and outcomes through clear storytelling and compelling visual communication. Support continuous improvement and change management activities that enhance growth execution, project delivery, and cross-business collaboration. Support the adoption of relevant AI tools and ways of working to improve project management, reporting, collaboration, and execution effectiveness. What you need to have: Approximately 10 years of professional experience in project or program management, preferably within professional services, consulting, financial services, insurance, or another complex, matrix environment. Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects, managing multiple stakeholders, monitoring delivery, and escalating risks or bottlenecks effectively. Strong stakeholder management, presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage senior and cross-functional audiences. Experience working with continuous improvement and change management initiatives. Strong understanding of commercial growth drivers, pipeline development, strategic programs, or market expansion initiatives. What makes you stand out? Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or a similar qualification. Experience supporting sector strategy, business development, growth initiatives, or commercial transformation across multiple business lines. Experience developing executive dashboards, performance reporting, and data-driven insights to support senior leadership decision-making. Experience with the adoption or implementation of AI tools in project management, business processes, reporting, or stakeholder collaboration. Experience working in an international or regional role across multiple countries, markets, or business units. Arabic language; fluent English is a must. Why join our team: We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders. We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities. Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our ability to deliver better outcomes for our colleagues, clients, and communities. Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.
